questions.question: If x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴ = 21/256 and x² + xy + y² = 3/16, then 2(x² + y²) = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ (x² + xy + y²) = 3/16 ---(1)

⇒ (x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴) = 21/256 ---(2)

**Formula used:**

As we know the following identity,

⇒ (x² + y² + xy) (x² + y² - xy) = (x² + y²)² - (xy)²

⇒ (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy) = x⁴ + y⁴ + 2x²y² - x²y²

⇒ (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy) = x⁴ + y⁴ + x²y²

**Calculation:**

⇒ x4 + y4 + x2y2 = (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy)

⇒ (21/256) = (3/16) (x² – xy + y²)

⇒ (x² – xy + y²) = 7/16 ---(2)

Add equation (1) and equation (2)

⇒ 2(x² + y²) = 10/16 = 5/8

questions.question: The average of eleven numbers is 68. The average of the first four numbers is 78 and that of the next four numbers is 63. The 9th number is two times the 11th number and the 10th number is 4 less than the 11th number. What is the average of the 9th and 11th numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Average of 11 numbers = 68

Average of first 4 numbers = 78

Average of next 4 numbers = 63

**Formula used:-**

Average = (Sum of values)/No. of values

**Calculation:-**

Average of 1 numbers = 68

Sum of 11 numbers = 68 × 11 = 748

Average of 4 numbers = 78

Sum of 4 numbers = 78 × 4 = 312

Average of next 4 numbers = 63

Sum of next 4 numbers = 63 × 4 = 252

Sum of 9th, 10th and 11th numbers

748 – 312 – 252 = 184

Let 11th number be x

9th number = 2x

10th number = x – 4

According to the question

x + 2x + x – 4 = 184

4x = 184 + 4 = 188

x = 47

11th number = 47

9th number = 2 × 47 = 94

Average of 9th number = (47 + 94)/2 = 141/2 = **70.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Average of 11 number = 68

Deviation of first 4 number = (68 – 78) × 4 = (-40)

Deviation of next 4 number = (68 – 63) × 4 = 20

Sum of 9th, 10th and 11th numbers = 3 × 68 – 40 + 20 = 184

According to the question

x + 2x + x – 4 = 184

4x = 184 + 4 = 188

x = 47

11th number = 47

9th number = 2 × 47 = 94

Average of 9th number = (47 + 94)/2 = 141/2 = **70.5**

questions.question: In an office, 70% of the total number of employees are females. 80% of the total number of employees, including 35 males, got promotion. If there are 105 female employees, then what percentage of female employees got promotion?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **female employees** = 105 (which is 70% of total)

Total employees = 105 ÷ 0.7 = 150

Total promoted = 80% of 150 = 120

Female promoted = Total promoted − Male promoted = 120 − 35 = 85

Required % = (85 ÷ 105) × 100 ≈ 80.95%

**∴ The correct answer is 80.95%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f057dc1096f5c09f7c5d678cb3e22ea41bb3ec6312221d75b90f5be54a949a3.png] 

**Given:**

**Females** = 70% of **Total Employees** = 105

**Promoted employees** = 80% of **Total Employees**

**Promoted males** = 35

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total employees = (105 ÷ 70) × 100 = 150

⇒ Total promoted employees = 80% of 150 = (80/100) × 150 = 120

⇒ Number of promoted females = Total promoted − Promoted males

⇒ Number of promoted females = 120 − 35 = 85

⇒ Percentage of female employees promoted = (Promoted females ÷ Total females) × 100

⇒ Required % = (85 ÷ 105) × 100 = (17 ÷ 21) × 100 ≈ 80.95%

**∴ The correct answer is 80.95%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Change

Always ensure the denominator (base) is the specific group asked for. Here, the base is **total female employees** (105), not the total office staff (150).

Percentage Formula

Percentage = (Value ÷ Total Value) × 100. This is the fundamental ratio used to compare parts of a whole.</p

questions.question: A started a business with a capital of Rs. 1,12,000. After 2 months, B joined the business with a capital of Rs, 80,000, and after another 2 months, C joined the business with a capital of Rs. 72,000. After 10 months from the start of the business, B withdrew Rs. 8,000 and C also withdrew Rs. 8,000. If B received Rs. 9,800 as his share in the profit at the end of a year, then the total profit was:
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

A invests 1,12,000

B invests 80,000

C invests 72,000

**Formula used:-**

Capital × Time = Profit

**Calculation:-**

Total capital of A at the end of the year = 112,000 × 12 = 13,44,000

Total capital of B at the end of the year = 80,000 × 8 + 72,000 × 2 = 6,40,000 + 1,44,000

= 7,84,000

Total capital of C at the end of the year = 72000 × 6 + 64000 × 2 = 432000 + 128000 = 560000

Profit ratio of A, B and C = 1344000 : 784000 : 560000 = 84 : 49 : 35

49x = 9800

x = 9800/49 = 200

Total Profit = (84x + 49x + 35x) = 168x = 168 × 200 = **Rs. 33600**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

See, 112000 : 80000 : 72000 : 8000 : 8000

We can write this,

14 : 10 : 9 : 1 : 1

Now,

Capital of A = 14

Capital of B = 10

Capital of C = 9

Total capital at the end of the year = 14 × 12 = 168

Total capital of B at the end of the year = 10 × 8 + 9 × 2 = 80 + 18 = 98

Total capital of C at the end of the year = 9 × 6 + 8 × 2 = 54 + 16 = 70

Profit share of A, B and C = 168 : 98 : 70

98 unit = 9800

1 unit = 100

Total profit = 168 + 98 + 70 = 336

336 unit = 336 × 100 = **Rs. 33600**

questions.question: The volume of a solid right circular cylinder is 5236 cm³, and its height is 34 cm. what is its curved surface area (in cm²)? (Take π = 22/7)

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

⇒ r² = (5236×7)over(22×34) 

⇒ r = √49 = 7 cm

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

⇒ 2 × 22over7 × 7 × 34 = 1496 cm²

questions.question: ABCD is cyclic quadrilateral. Sides AB and DC, when produced, meet at E, and sides BC and AD, when produced, meet at F. If ∠BFA = 60° and ∠AED = 30°, then the measure of ∠ABC is:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **cyclic quadrilateral** ABCD where sides AB, DC meet at E and BC, AD meet at F:

∠ABC = [180° + ∠AED − ∠BFA] ÷ 2

∠ABC = [180° + 30° − 60°] ÷ 2

∠ABC = 150° ÷ 2 = 75°

**∴ The correct answer is 75°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ∠BFA = 60°, ∠AED = 30°

**Formula Used:** Sum of opposite angles in a **cyclic quadrilateral** is 180°. Sum of angles in a **triangle** is 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e35b0d15985bcbec0af98edd903ebfd58895b247384bd9ab24fcbfd0340491e.png] 

Let ∠ABC = x and ∠BCD = y.

⇒ In ΔEBC, ∠E + ∠EBC + ∠ECB = 180°

⇒ 30° + (180° − x) + (180° − y) = 180°

⇒ x + y = 210° ... (1)

⇒ In cyclic quad ABCD, ∠ADC = 180° − x.

⇒ In ΔFDC, ∠F + ∠FCD + ∠FDC = 180°

⇒ 60° + (180° − y) + (180° − (180° − x)) = 180°

⇒ 60° + 180° − y + x = 180°

⇒ y − x = 60° ... (2)

⇒ Adding equations (1) and (2): 2y = 270° ⇒ y = 135°

⇒ Subtracting equation (2) from (1): 2x = 150° ⇒ x = 75°

**∴ The correct answer is 75°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cyclic Quadrilateral Properties

The sum of opposite angles is 180°. The exterior angle at any vertex is equal to the interior opposite angle.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.

Intersecting Chords Theorem

If two chords intersect inside a circle, the product of the segments of one chord equals the product of the segments of the other (PA × PB = PC × PD).</p

questions.question: Seven years ago, the ages (in years) of A and B were in the ratio 4 : 5 and 7 years hence, their ages will be in the ratio 5 : 6. What will be the ratio of their ages 5 years from now?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Seven years ago = 4 : 5

Seven years hence = 5 : 6

**Calculation:**

Ages ratio of A and B seven years ago = 4x : 5x

According to the question,

⇒ (4x + 14)/(5x + 14) = 5/6

⇒ 6(4x + 14) = 5(5x + 14)

⇒ 24x + 84 = 25x + 70

⇒ 25x – 24x = 84 – 70

⇒ x = 14

Seven years ago age of A = 4 × 14 = 56

5 years after the age of A = 56 + 12 = 68

Seven years ago age of B = 5 × 14 = 70

5years hence age of B = 70

questions.question: The speed of train A is 16 km/h less than the speed of train B. To cover a distance of 384 km, B takes 4 hours less time than A. What is the speed (in km/h) of train B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of train B - Speed of train A = 16 km/h

Distance = 384 km

Time of A - Time of B = 4 hours

**Calculation:**

Let speed of Train B be x km/hr.

⇒ Speed of Train A = (x – 16) km/hr

According to the question,

{384/(x – 16)} – {384/x} = 4

384[(x – x + 16)/{x(x – 16)}] = 4

384 × 16/(x² – 16x) = 4

384 × 4 = x² – 16x

x² – 16x – 1536 = 0

x² – 48x + 32n – 1536 = 0

x(x – 48) + 32(x – 48) = 0

(x – 48) (x + 32) = 0

Taking ,

x + 32 = 0

x = -32 [Speed can not be negative]

Taking,

x – 48 = 0

x = 48

∴ Speed of Train B is **48 km/hr**.
